zh: 样例 [7,4,3,8,2] 的答案 782 说明三个数位必须按原数组的先后顺序选取，不能重排；首位还必须非零。
数组最多 50 个数位，直接枚举三个递增下标 i<j<k 的所有组合也只有约两万种，取能组成的最大值即可。
best 初始为 −1；三重循环枚举 i<j<k，跳过 nums[i]=0 的情况，用 100×nums[i]+10×nums[j]+nums[k] 更新 best；最后输出 best（无合法组合时保持 −1）。
en: The sample [7,4,3,8,2] with answer 782 shows that the three digits must be picked in their original order without rearranging, and the leading digit must be non-zero.
There are at most 50 digits, so enumerating every triple of increasing indices i < j < k is only about twenty thousand combinations; keep the largest number formed.
Set best = -1; loop over all i < j < k, skip cases with nums[i] = 0, and update best with 100*nums[i] + 10*nums[j] + nums[k]; print best at the end (it stays -1 when no valid choice exists).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate three indices `i < j < k`. If `nums[i]` is not zero, compute `100*nums[i] + 10*nums[j] + nums[k]` and update the maximum. The array has at most 50 elements, so a direct triple loop is enough. When there is no valid choice, output -1 as this site specifies.

## Correctness

Every valid answer corresponds to a unique triple of increasing indices `i < j < k` whose first digit is non-zero. The algorithm enumerates all such triples and computes the corresponding three-digit number, so no valid answer is missed; taking the largest of them is exactly what the problem asks for. If no combination satisfies the non-zero leading digit condition, the result stays -1, matching the no-solution rule added by this site.

## Complexity

Time O(N^3), extra space O(1).

## Sources and site conventions

Fixed OAMaster snapshot: https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/google#21-find-largest-number-google-early-career; content fingerprint `df9e04f772003ef1996bb410a0e9712db3d5fb1c857806257d19cdbea2362698`. Its example `[7,4,3,8,2] -> 782` agrees with choosing `7,8,2` in the original array order; if arbitrary rearrangement were allowed, the maximum would be 874. The 1Point3Acres material for the same problem only confirms that three elements are chosen from the array to form the largest three-digit number, and gives no example that settles the ordering: https://www.1point3acres.com/interview/problems/google-find-largest-number. The ordering is therefore recovered from the fixed OAMaster example. The original OA does not define the output when no valid three-digit number exists; this site specifies -1. N, the digit range and the standard input/output protocol are additions by this site and do not represent upstream constraints.
